title: Vice Salt Nic E-Liquid – Blue Raspberry Ice 30ml
description:
Description
Introducing Blue Raspberry Ice by Vice – the latest addition to the Vice brand’s line of premium salt nicotine e-liquids. Satisfy your cravings with the deliciously sweet and tart flavor of ripe blue raspberries, perfectly balanced with a cooling blast of ice.
Crafted with the same attention to detail and commitment to quality as Vice’s high-performance disposable vapes, this e-liquid delivers a smooth and satisfying vaping experience that’s perfect for both novice and experienced vapers alike.
Formulated with high-quality ingredients and available in a convenient 30ml bottle, Blue Raspberry Ice by Vice is the perfect choice for those looking for a tasty and refreshing vape that packs a punch.
Whether you’re looking to switch from traditional smoking to vaping or just looking for a new and exciting flavor to add to your collection, Blue Raspberry Ice by Vice is the perfect choice for you. Try it today and experience the ultimate in vaping pleasure!
Flavour Notes:
Blue Raspberry
Ice
Vice E-Liquid is NOT intended for use in Sub-Ohm Tank systems. Vice E-Liquid is intended for small pod systems.
50% VG 50% PG
